title: Evergreen Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists Evergreen Account fees, earnings, and limits: $6.00 monthly maintenance (waived with $500+ minimum daily balance), 0.05% APY, $7.50/month paper statements (e-statements avoid it), $17.00 returned deposit fee, and $12.50 incoming domestic wire fee. It also states a $4,500 debit card daily purchase limit and $750 daily ATM withdrawal limit, plus requirements to maintain good standing.
